units.function: Monolithic Company Skill library and runtime orchestration service covering source discovery/import, catalog provenance, filesystem materialization, CRUD, versions, forks, comments/stars, policy-adjacent audit/update/reset, Agent desired-state projection and Issue-backed test runs.
units.dependencyDirection: HTTP routes call this service, which directly owns Drizzle tables, filesystem trees, GitHub transport, catalog packages, Project/Folder/Agent services, adapter configuration, Issue/Document/Asset/Work Product projections and test-run callbacks. Domain, persistence, supply-chain, runtime and presentation concerns flow into one 6,956-line module.
units.keyDataModels: CompanySkill and metadata provenance, path/kind inventories, content-bearing CompanySkillVersion, source/trust/compatibility/sharing, catalog origin hash/snapshot/update hold, Agent desired Skill/version, fork/reassignment, comment/star, test input/template/run, Issue-backed artifacts/cost and process-local refresh promise.
units.lifecycle: Discover or import a local/remote/catalog package; derive key/trust/inventory; upsert and materialize files; reconcile missing/bundled sources on reads; edit/version/fork/rename/update/reset/delete; project desired entries into Agent runtime directories; create an Issue-backed test run, wake/cancel it, collect artifacts/output/cost and retain or prune the harness.
units.testAssessment: Companion audits prove useful boundary intent but not the whole service: company-skills filesystem/parser tests passed 17/19 with two macOS realpath expectation failures; company-skills-detail ran 0/2 because embedded PostgreSQL could not start; company-skill-import-boundary strongly exercises canonical workspace containment. Major uncovered or weakly covered risks include multi-process races, crash recovery across filesystem/database sagas, aggregate resource limits, remote content integrity/SSRF, secret redaction, terminal-run races, approval/responsibility binding and destructive reconciliation.
units.designRationale: Provide a complete Skills Studio and portable Agent-capability experience in one server service while incrementally hardening imports through pinned Git refs, path containment, catalog hashes, audits, version snapshots and conservative desired-state projection.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a vendor-neutral, secret-free capability supply chain that can ingest FDE/customer packages, bind immutable digests and data/tool grants to approved Work, distribute leased capabilities to heterogeneous Connector nodes, attest actual activation and preserve evidence through update, rollback and revocation.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT behind separate SkillRegistry, PackageQuarantine, CapabilityPolicy, RuntimeMaterializer and TestExecution ports. ADAPT the canonical-root/symlink checks, pinned Git commit rule, reserved-key defense, explicit conflict modes, deterministic content hashing, atomic same-parent directory replacement, row-locked version allocation, stale desired-reference visibility, origin snapshot verification and rich artifact projection. Do not copy the god-service or its Paperclip adapter/schema coupling.
units.responsibilityConflict: Mutating/force actions are not bound to an accountable human, approval, exact package/action digest, data/tool grant or immutable evidence. Test safety relies on prompt instructions, Agent configuration snapshots may retain secrets, runtime materialization can silently omit files, and read-time reconciliation can hard-delete unused missing-source records.
evidence: server/src/__tests__/company-skills.test.ts:1-433; focused run 17/19 passed with two /var vs /private/var failures
server/src/__tests__/company-skills-detail.test.ts:1-232; 0/2 executed because embedded PostgreSQL failed to start
securityFindings: Critical: test-run snapshots persist full adapterConfig and runtimeConfig without a visible redaction or allowlist, risking credential, private-session and sensitive-endpoint retention.

External GitHub/skills.sh imports require a pinned 40-hex commit and reject classified executable scripts, but generic HTTPS sources are unpinned and remote inventories do not fetch/hash every claimed file.

Local workspace imports use realpath containment and reject symlinks, yet recursive collection is unbounded and path validation/read remain vulnerable to substitution races and hard-link or mount edge cases.

Multiple create/fork/edit/delete/update/reset/runtime flows cross filesystem and database without a durable saga/outbox; failures can leave overwritten bytes, partial rows, stale counters or missing versions.
Managed create/fork force-delete target directories after race-prone in-memory conflict checks; concurrent requests can overwrite another operation before database uniqueness is authoritative.
Runtime materialization may silently skip unreadable files and only requires SKILL.md, so actual capabilities can differ from the approved inventory without a structured activation failure.
Ordinary inventory refresh hard-deletes missing, unused local Skill rows and runtime materializations without grace period, tombstone, approval or immutable activity evidence.
Test harness safety is expressed as natural-language instructions rather than sandbox/capability/data-egress enforcement, and run completion has select-then-update races between terminal outcomes.
